evidence_boundary: This contract pre-registers a future issue-aligned SWE-T1 scorer/test path. It does not replace current paper-facing SWE-T1 rows and does not add task-success evidence.

model_visible_inputs: model-visible source context when using a source-context follow-up

paired_run_policy.base_model_policy: Use GPT-family gpt-5.5 unless explicitly running an LLM ablation.

issue_aligned_success_criteria: A TSQL single-table query without an alias must not trigger L031.
A TSQL single-table query with an alias must not trigger L031.
A TSQL query with aliases in a join must still trigger L031 as a regression guard.
The candidate patch must apply cleanly before the issue-aligned check runs.
next_action: Validate the issue-aligned check against base and known candidate patches locally, then run paired Summary/PaperToSkill only if the paper needs a stronger SWE-T1 row.
